Sandbox_GrappleHook_MaxFloors_tooltip: How many floors above the player a grapple shot may reach. 1 allows only the floor directly above.
Sandbox_GrappleHook_MaxRange_tooltip: Horizontal distance in tiles between the player and the window.
Sandbox_GrappleHook_BreakWindows_tooltip: When enabled, a closed intact window is smashed by the hook so the rope can be tied. When disabled, only open or already broken windows accept a rope.
Sandbox_GrappleHook_NoiseRadius_tooltip: World sound radius of the launch, which attracts zombies. 0 fires silently.
Sandbox_GrappleHook_Debug_tooltip: Print grapple targeting, validation and server decisions to console.txt.
